result.instructions: Tools for Baremetrics, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "What is our MRR and ARR this month compared with 30 days ago?"; "Which customers drove the MRR drop last week?"; "Show churn per plan for the last 90 days.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Baremetrics data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run baremetrics_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run baremetrics_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run baremetrics_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. baremetrics_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: baremetrics_get_account
tools.title: Get account
tools.description: Get the Baremetrics account: company name, default currency and creation date. Baremetrics API: GET /v1/account.

tools.name: baremetrics_list_sources
tools.title: List sources
tools.description: List the connected data sources (for example Stripe, Recurly, or Baremetrics-managed data). Each source id scopes the customer, plan, subscription, charge and event tools. Baremetrics API: GET /v1/sources.

tools.name: baremetrics_get_metrics_summary
tools.title: Get metrics summary
tools.description: Get all key SaaS metrics (MRR, ARR, ARPU, LTV, churn, new customers and more) per day for a date range. Baremetrics API: GET /v1/metrics.

tools.name: baremetrics_get_metric
tools.title: Get metric time series
tools.description: Get the daily time series of one metric for a date range, with an optional comparison to N days earlier. Baremetrics API: GET /v1/metrics/{metric}.

metric.description: Metric name, e.g. mrr, arr, active_customers, churn (see Baremetrics 'Available Metrics').

compare_to.description: Days ago to compare with, e.g. 30.

tools.name: baremetrics_get_metric_customers
tools.title: Get customers for a metric
tools.description: List the customers that contribute to one metric for a date range (for example who drove MRR changes). Baremetrics API: GET /v1/metrics/{metric}/customers.

metric.description: Metric name, e.g. mrr, arr, active_customers, churn (see Baremetrics 'Available Metrics').

tools.name: baremetrics_get_metric_plans
tools.title: Get plan breakout for a metric
tools.description: Break one metric down by plan for a date range (for example MRR per plan). Baremetrics API: GET /v1/metrics/{metric}/plans.

metric.description: Metric name, e.g. mrr, arr, active_customers, churn (see Baremetrics 'Available Metrics').

annotations.title: Get plan breakout for a metric

tools.name: baremetrics_get_cohorts
tools.title: Get cohort retention
tools.description: Get cohort analysis (customer retention by signup month). Baremetrics API: GET /v1/metrics/cohorts.

tools.name: baremetrics_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List or search the customers of one source. Baremetrics API: GET /v1/{source_id}/customers.

order.description: Sort direction, e.g. asc or desc.

tools.name: baremetrics_get_customer
tools.title: Get customer
tools.description: Get one customer by id. Baremetrics API: GET /v1/{source_id}/customers/{oid}.

tools.name: baremetrics_list_customer_events
tools.title: List customer events
tools.description: List the event history of one customer (signups, upgrades, cancellations). Baremetrics API: GET /v1/{source_id}/customers/{oid}/events.

tools.name: baremetrics_list_subscriptions
tools.title: List subscriptions
tools.description: List subscriptions of one source, optionally for one customer. Baremetrics API: GET /v1/{source_id}/subscriptions.

order.description: Sort direction, e.g. asc or desc.

tools.name: baremetrics_get_subscription
tools.title: Get subscription
tools.description: Get one subscription by id. Baremetrics API: GET /v1/{source_id}/subscriptions/{oid}.

tools.name: baremetrics_list_plans
tools.title: List plans
tools.description: List or search the plans of one source. Baremetrics API: GET /v1/{source_id}/plans.

tools.name: baremetrics_get_plan
tools.title: Get plan
tools.description: Get one plan by id. Baremetrics API: GET /v1/{source_id}/plans/{oid}.

tools.name: baremetrics_list_charges
tools.title: List charges
tools.description: List charges of one source, optionally filtered by date range, subscription or customer. Baremetrics API: GET /v1/{source_id}/charges.

end.description: Charges up to this date, yyyy-mm-dd.

tools.name: baremetrics_get_charge
tools.title: Get charge
tools.description: Get one charge by id. Baremetrics API: GET /v1/{source_id}/charges/{oid}.

tools.name: baremetrics_list_events
tools.title: List events
tools.description: List subscription events of one source (new, upgrade, downgrade, cancel and more), optionally by date range. Baremetrics API: GET /v1/{source_id}/events.

live_stream.description: Live stream filter, as the API documents it.

end.description: Events up to this date, yyyy-mm-dd.

tools.name: baremetrics_list_annotations
tools.title: List annotations
tools.description: List the chart annotations (notes on metric dates). Baremetrics API: GET /v1/annotations.

tools.name: baremetrics_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List the users of the Baremetrics account (use an id from here as user_id for an annotation). Baremetrics API: GET /v1/users.

tools.name: baremetrics_create_annotation
tools.title: Create annotation
tools.description: Add a note to a metric on one date, shown on the Baremetrics charts (for example 'Price change'). Adds one record; it does not change metrics or customers. Baremetrics API: POST /v1/annotations.

metric.description: Metric name, e.g. mrr, arr, active_customers, churn (see Baremetrics 'Available Metrics').

global.description: true = show on all graphs; false = only on the metric's graph.

user_id.description: Id of the user who adds the note (from baremetrics_list_users).

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Baremetrics
prompts.description: What you can do with Baremetrics here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: compare_mrr_and_arr_with_an_earlier_date
prompts.title: Compare MRR and ARR with an earlier date
prompts.description: Read the daily series of one metric, with a comparison to an earlier period. Read all key SaaS metrics for the same date range.

prompts.name: find_the_customers_behind_a_metric_change
prompts.title: Find the customers behind a metric change
prompts.description: List the customers that contribute to one metric in a date range. Open one customer to read its details.

prompts.name: break_mrr_down_by_plan
prompts.title: Break MRR down by plan
prompts.description: Split one metric by plan for a date range. List the plans to read their names and details.

prompts.name: review_cancellations_and_cohort_retention
prompts.title: Review cancellations and cohort retention
prompts.description: List subscription events such as cancels and downgrades in a date range. Read cohort retention by signup month.

prompts.name: add_a_note_for_a_price_change
prompts.title: Add a note for a price change
prompts.description: List the users, then add a note on a metric date, such as a price change. The note appears on the chart and changes no metric data.
